description: This file defines a feature for retrieving detailed information about an article based on its slug. It includes a query class, a validator for the query, and a handler that fetches the article data from the database, throwing an exception if not found.

classes.name: Details
classes.description: Contains the query, validator, and handler classes for retrieving article details.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the query to retrieve an article by slug, returning an envelope with article data or throwing a not found exception.
